Name: Gigi - Style Beardless Wizard Portraits (and sprites) for RRRR
Author: bugboydarklord
Description:
This is my first time making a Stardew mod, so don't expect to find any code in this. You'll just be replacing existing files.

FOR SPRITES: 
Open your RRRR folder in the Mods file.
Click "[CP] RRRR" then open "assets" then "Characters"
Dump all the sprites in this folder, and click yes when asked to replace files.

FOR PORTRAITS:
Simply dump the portraits into whichever portraiture file you're currently using :D

Expect seasonal portraits and hairstyles soon. I'll probably make it a separate mod, but I'll need some time (or help) figuring out how to change the code to suit the fact that this Wizz already has medium length hair.. Anyways I hope you like the little changes I made to him. I wanted him to be more shiny and magical like the Twizard from RRRR, but a little less cutesy and purple. If you do know how to fiddle with the code from this mod (https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17284), please let me know. Especially with Hi-res portraits!!!
